approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a simple landscape 16:9 before-and-after comparison collage using the two supplied photographs. Place the FIRST image (old kitchen with brown cabinets) on the LEFT and the SECOND image (renovated kitchen with white cabinets) on the RIGHT. Preserve both photographs as supplied: no restyling, retouching, reconstruction, changes to objects, lighting, colors, or perspective. Fit each entire photograph proportionally into equal-width side-by-side panels without stretching or cropping. Use clean neutral white space as needed to accommodate the original aspect ratios. Align the two photos neatly at the same size and height, with a narrow white divider. Add clear simple black labels in white header space above each respective photo: exactly “Before” above the left photo and exactly “After” above the right photo. Only layout and labels; keep the photos themselves unchanged.
